maddeler.e:
نبتكر (form VIII)
# نَبْتَكِرُ (nabtakiru) /nab.ta.ki.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# نُبْتَكَرُ (nubtakaru) /nub.ta.ka.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# نَبْتَكِرَ (nabtakira) /nab.ta.ki.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# نُبْتَكَرَ (nubtakara) /nub.ta.ka.ra/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
